items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Terminology 63:1
items.html: The HGT of Atik impart Hochma to the level of AB, which is AA; and the NHY of Atik impart Hassadim to the level of SAG, which is the HGT of AA and the upper AVI, as is known. Therefore, in every place to which the Yesod of Atik extends in the Chazeh [chest] of AA, covered Hassadim are found there, and the illumination of Hochma cannot be revealed there. However, when the drop of the coupling of AB SAG of AK reaches Atzilut, bringing the bottom Hey down from the Parsas, and AA and Atik become one Partzuf, then the NHY of AA, which are the discernment of the illumination of Hochma, ascend to the place of the NHY of Atik. Through this the screen of the Yesod of Atik, which detains the revelation of the light of Hochma, is annulled, and then both the HGT of AA and the upper AVI receive the discernment of revealed Hassadim in the illumination of Hochma. And this is discerned as the Yesod of Atik having been split lengthwise — meaning that its detaining screen is annulled and passes away, and the measure of length is revealed in it, that is, the illumination of Hochma, for Hochma is designated by the name length, as is known. (Page 920, Item 89).
